findingDetails.title: The per-run temp folder is removed on a clean exit only
findingDetails.scopeProof: The whole cleanup path is this one exit listener; rg -n "RUN_TMPDIR|rmSync" vitest.config.ts returns exactly these four lines.
findingDetails.case: A suite run cancelled by concurrency.cancel-in-progress receives a termination signal; the exit listener never runs and the sav-* folder with its health records stays in the temp directory.

findingDetails.title: The suite isolation sets only the variable POSIX reads
findingDetails.scopeProof: No win32 branch exists in runtime/lib or runtime/scripts, and no workflow runs on windows-*, so the platform is uncovered rather than a live regression.
findingDetails.case: A Windows checkout runs npm test; os.tmpdir() reads TEMP/TMP there, so DURABLE_METRICS_ROOT stays in the shared %TEMP% folder and the run's records count as real use.

results.summary: REQ-001 and AC-001 read against the config block; the main path matches, the stress config is left for the traceability pass.

searchLedger.hypothesis: a whole-repository listing still aborts the build after the raised cap

searchActions.result: default cap returns status null with ENOBUFS and 1,114,112 bytes; 512 MiB returns status 0 with 1,116,018 bytes

searchLedger.rationale: the raised cap reads the fixture listing that the default cap truncates, and this checkout's own listing is 20,432,037 bytes
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: reproduced the overflow at the default cap and its absence at 512 MiB

searchLedger.hypothesis: the per-run folder can survive a run that does not end through process.exit

searchActions.queryOrPath: node with an exit listener, killed with SIGTERM
searchActions.result: no marker file written; the same script ending through process.exit(0) writes it

searchLedger.rationale: a cancelled run leaves the folder and its records behind

searchLedger.hypothesis: TMPDIR is not the variable os.tmpdir() reads on every platform

searchActions.queryOrPath: runtime/lib/metrics.ts:185 and node:os tmpdir() platform rule
searchActions.result: Windows reads TEMP/TMP and never TMPDIR
no match, so the platform is untested rather than broken today

searchLedger.rationale: the isolation is silently absent on a platform the runtime never branches for

searchLedger.hypothesis: a temp path 11 bytes longer pushes an IPC socket past sun_path

searchActions.result: default socket dir is /tmp/system-skill-advisor and a long one is relocated by withinLimitOrRelocated

searchLedger.rationale: the socket directory is not derived from tmpdir(), and the limit has its own relocation path
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: no socket path in this runtime resolves under tmpdir()
